subject: Separate preliminary archived operational RFC guidance accuracy; no public forecast dissemination inference
stage_scope: site-local stage, not elevation, discharge, inundation, humanitarian effectiveness, or history of funding
cohort_inclusion: Select only exact pairs coded ARCHIVE_COMPATIBLE_RFC_GUIDANCE_ONLY at the pinned outcome-blind commit. The 13 other planned windows remain unavailable, not scored. The original public stage gate remains blocked and is not reopened.
issue_clock: max(RFC WMO, SHEF creation DC, unique time-corroborated HML issue); an archive vintage clock and not actual public release or exact operator receipt. Forecast issue and numeric stage must be the pinned selected pair.
historical_site_before_scoring: Record date-specific station identity, stable stage datum tie, and any relocation or datum issue from official metadata. Unresolved or conflicting tie: withhold that event's numerical score, preserve pending reason; no offset estimation from the held values.
truth_join_policy: One exact UTC instant and held series per pair; no nearby timestamp, rate rating, alternative gauge, conversion, in-fill, rounding for matching or substitution. Scores require one exactly eligible feature, no more than one feature, no pagination, null qualifier, approved numeric finite value; record distinct missing/ambiguous/invalid/transport reasons and artifact hashes.
primary_summary: Equal-event MAE in feet over all three events and all 11 target pairs, defined only if all pairs pass and all event-stage datum ties documented. For each event MAE_e = mean(abs(guidance_ft - approved_gage_height_ft)); macro MAE = (MAE_KY + MAE_OH + MAE_Helene)/3.
secondary_descriptive: Report exact signed and absolute residual per eligible pair, MAE and signed bias per event with n_eligible/n_locked; report partial event results explicitly as observed subset, not primary complete-cohort result. For complete cohort, add equal-event mean signed residual and pooled MAE only as secondary. Retain lead minutes and status for all 11. Count 3 event clusters, not 11 independent floods.
no_inference: No fitted model, tuned rules, thresholds/alerts, independent forecast baselines, hypothesis tests, confidence intervals, improvement/ranking claim, deployment inference, pooling as independent trials, or outcome-based methods change. No broad comparison or performance grading from this purposive three-event set.
